# The sidebar sliding in and out (animated, as in the app): the terminal
# keeps its grid through the slide and takes the new width once, when the
# slide ends — not at every frame, which redrew everything and had the shell
# redraw its prompt mid-way (the content jumped). The text size never changes.
# (With Reduce Motion on in System Settings nothing slides: it passes anyway.)
wait:1.0
# (The grid it starts with counts as one; from here on, the slides.)
expect-regrids:1
expect-font:13
motion:on
# action: waits 0.6 s — the slide is over, its 1 s fallback isn't: the
# change came when the slide said it ended.
action:toggle_sidebar
expect-regrids:1
expect-font:13
action:toggle_sidebar
expect-regrids:1
expect-font:13
# A second toggle 0.1 s into the first, back where it was: no slide lets go
# of the other's hold, and the grid never changes.
action-now:toggle_sidebar
wait:0.1
action-now:toggle_sidebar
wait:1.5
expect-regrids:0
expect-font:13
# And back into the terminal from the sidebar.
key:shift+tab
wait:0.5
expect-regrids:0
expect-font:13
